title: Support, cohomology and shifted Hom comparisons for open derived restriction
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with derived localizations [def-pc-derived-category] of morphism universe $w$ for structure-sheaf modules on $X$ and on every localized open site. For every open $U$, choose localizations on its open subscheme and all its opens in universe $w$. Put $L=D(\operatorname{overFunctor}_U)$ and $M=D(\operatorname{overFunctor}_U\circ\operatorname{Modules.overEquiv}_U)$ (restriction followed by the canonical module equivalence). There is a right adjoint $R$ with $L\dashv R$. For every $K$, quasi-coherent cohomology of $K$ implies quasi-coherent cohomology of $M(K)$. For every subset $T\subseteq X$, zero cohomology stalks of $K$ outside $T$ imply zero cohomology stalks of $M(K)$ outside the inverse image of $T$. For all $Q,K$ and $n\in\mathbb Z$, subsingleton $\operatorname{Hom}(L(Q[n]),L(K))$ implies subsingleton $\operatorname{Hom}(M(Q)[n],M(K))$. Finally $M(K)=0$ implies $L(K)=0$. There is no detector, perfection or compactness assumption.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-open-derived-localization-adjunction] to obtain the fixed-universe localizations and R with its adjunction. Put e = Modules.overEquiv U and F = overFunctor U followed by e. Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso identifies M with L followed by D(e).

Apply [lem-pc-derived-open-restriction-qcoh-iff] and SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent_over in each degree to get preservation of quasi-coherent cohomology. Functor.mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso and Modules.overFunctorEquiv identify the homology of M(K) with restriction of the homology of K. Modules.restrictStalkNatIso then identifies its stalk at x with the original stalk at x.val. IsZero of that additive group transports along the stalk isomorphism, proving support for every subset T.

The exact equivalence e induces a fully faithful derived functor D(e). The composition comparison identifies the Hom types before and after D(e). The canonical commShiftIso of M identifies M(Q[n]) with M(Q)[n], so these Hom equivalences transport subsingletonness. If M(K) is zero, the composition comparison makes D(e)(L(K)) zero. Full faithfulness reflects zero objects by IsZero.of_full_of_faithful_of_isZero. No restriction of a detector or invertibility of a global adjunction unit is used.

theorem open_derived_restriction_comparison
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (U : X.Opens) :
    ∃ hD : HasDerivedCategory.{w}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)),
    letI := hD
    ∃ hO : ∀ W : U.toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over W)),
    letI := hO
    let L := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory
    let M := ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory
    ∃ (R : DerivedCategory
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ⥤
        schemeDerivedCategory X) (_ : L ⊣ R),
      (∀ K : schemeDerivedCategory X, schemeDerivedQCohProperty X K →
        schemeDerivedQCohProperty U.toScheme (M.obj K)) ∧
      (∀ (T : Set X) (K : schemeDerivedCategory X),
        (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T →
          Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj K).val.presheaf x))) →
        ∀ (n : ℤ) (x : U.toScheme), x.val ∉ T →
          Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) n).obj
              (M.obj K)).val.presheaf x))) ∧
      (∀ (Q K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (n : ℤ),
        Subsingleton (L.obj (Q⟦n⟧) ⟶ L.obj K) →
        Subsingleton ((M.obj Q)⟦n⟧ ⟶ M.obj K)) ∧
      (∀ K : schemeDerivedCategory X, IsZero (M.obj K) → IsZero (L.obj K))
